Game_Attendances: Total number of Game events attended by each member.
Workshop_AttendanceDate: Latest attendance date based on date where EventType = 'Workshop'
Workshop_Attendances: Total number of Workshop events attended by each member.
Total_Attendances: Total events attended by each member. I tried on one categories but I have to do this calculation for another 2 categories then that will add up another 2 sub queries. Is there anyway to optimize the SQL code?

    COALESCE(a.MemberID, b.MemberID) AS MemberID,

    drivers.surname,

FROM

JOIN 
    results

FROM
    drivers
JOIN
    results
ON
    drivers.driverid = results.driverid
GROUP BY
    drivers.forename,
    drivers.surname

    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('laps', results.laps, 'position', results.position)) @? '$[*] ? (@.laps == 56) ? (@.position == 1)';

query: In the superhero database, we want to identify a list of superheroes who have only the superpowers of 'Flight' and 'Telepathy' and do not possess any other superpowers. The following query seems to work, but I suspect there might be a more efficient way to achieve this result.
issue_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.id
FROM superhero s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
    WHERE s.id = hp.hero_id AND sp.power_name = 'Flight'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
    WHERE s.id = hp.hero_id AND sp.power_name = 'Telepathy'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
    WHERE s.id = hp.hero_id AND sp.power_name NOT IN ('Flight', 'Telepathy')
);

issue_sql: WITH constructor_roles AS ( SELECT 18 race_id, 1 constructor_id, false customer_billing, true commander, true agent UNION ALL SELECT 18, 2, true, false, false ) SELECT n.race_id, string_agg(distinct CASE WHEN n.customer_billing = TRUE THEN 'AR (Customer Billing)' WHEN n.commander = TRUE THEN 'AP (Commander)' WHEN n.agent = TRUE THEN 'AP (Agent)' ELSE NULL END, ', ') AS finance FROM constructor_roles n WHERE n.race_id = 18 AND (n.customer_billing = TRUE or n.commander = TRUE or n.agent = TRUE) GROUP BY race_id
